# XCCEL8 Advanced Solutions LLC

> One-stop full-stack IT solutions provider in Dubai, UAE. Authorized reseller for 101+ global technology brands, with free consultation, expert implementation, and long-term AMC support.

## About

XCCEL8 Advanced Solutions LLC is a Dubai-based IT solutions company serving SMEs across the UAE and GCC. We cover four pillars: Network Infrastructure, Business Applications, Compute & Cloud, and Cyber + Physical Security. We are authorized resellers for Microsoft, Zoho, Fortinet, Sophos, Lenovo, Honeywell, and 95+ other brands.

## Services

### Network Infrastructure
Wi-Fi, switching & routing, structured cabling, IP telephony, conference room solutions, laptops and endpoints.
https://www.xccel8.com/network/

### Business Applications
Zoho (Books, CRM, People, Creator), Microsoft 365, ERP/CRM/HRMS implementation, accounting software, e-invoicing (UAE FTA-compliant via MoF-accredited ASP).
https://www.xccel8.com/application/

### Compute & Cloud
Cloud, on-premises & hybrid infrastructure — servers, HCI, storage, backup, and disaster recovery.
https://www.xccel8.com/compute/

### Cyber & Physical Security
Firewalls, endpoint protection, CCTV, access control (SIRA-compliant installations via certified partners).
https://www.xccel8.com/security/

### AI Consulting & Implementation
AI agents integrated with business workflows. Process discovery, AI solution design, implementation, and support. Serving UAE & GCC, 100% online.
https://www.xccel8.com/services/ai-consulting/

## Who We Serve

Small and medium enterprises (10–500 employees) in the UAE and GCC across trading, retail, hospitality, healthcare, education, professional services, and light industry.
